title: Great Weaponry
description: Adds new sets of weapons armors and a couple of new cosmetic items with the curios Api
body:
This mod adds new weapon types for iron, steel (made by smelting iron in a blast furnace), diamond, and netherite. These weapons all have different abilities.

It also adds a steel armor set, a reinforced steel armor set with different helmets that grant different set bonuses, and a blazing steel armor set that also has its own different helmets that grant different set bonuses.

Additionally, it adds cosmetic items crafted in a stonecutter using the new cosmetic goo item, which can be bought from the wandering trader. These items are purely cosmetic and grant no bonus effects.
